item.title: FTSE 100 gains as Next and Glencore impress
item.summary: The FTSE 100 was higher on Wednesday as corporate updates continued to impress and hopes of a deal in the Middle East boosted sentiment. It was the turn of Next and Glencore to reveal positive numbers on Wednesday, with both stocks among the FTSE 100’s top risers.
